question_text: Find the transformed equation whose roots are the negatives of the roots of x⁴ + 5x³ + 11x + 3 = 0.

recall_prompt: Say what you replace x by, and which terms change sign as a result.
insider_note: Only the odd-power terms change sign; the x² term is absent here, so exactly two signs flip.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Replace x by −x
steps.margin_note: First mark. New roots −α ⇒ α = −x, so the required equation is f(−x) = 0. Even powers keep their sign, odd powers change it.
steps.memory_tip: New roots −α means α = −x, so the equation is f(−x) = 0. Even powers keep their sign.

recall.must_convey: That the equation whose roots are the negatives of the old ones is f(−x) = 0, obtained by replacing x by −x.
accept: replace x by minus x because the new roots are the negatives
the required equation is f of minus x equals zero
put minus x in place of x
x place lo minus x pettali, f of minus x equals zero
negative roots means substitute minus x

steps.why: If f(α) = 0 then f(−(−α)) = 0, so −α is a root of f(−x) = 0. The rule 'change the sign of the odd-power terms' is the consequence, not the reason.
common_mistakes: Changing the sign of every term, which gives back the same equation.
Changing the sign of the even-power terms instead of the odd ones.

steps.label: Simplify
steps.margin_note: Second mark. (−x)⁴ = x⁴, (−x)³ = −x³, −x stays. Only the x³ and x terms change sign.
steps.memory_tip: (−x)⁴ = x⁴ and (−x)³ = −x³. The x² term is missing, so exactly two signs flip.

recall.must_convey: That simplifying f(−x) gives x⁴ − 5x³ − 11x + 3 = 0: only the odd-power terms change sign.
accept: simplify and the equation is x four minus five x cube minus eleven x plus three, only the odd powers change sign
the answer is x to the four minus five x cubed minus eleven x plus three equals zero
x to the four stays, five x cube and eleven x become negative
odd powers sign marutundi, x four minus five x cube minus eleven x plus three
the even power terms keep their sign and the odd ones flip

steps.why: (−x)ⁿ is xⁿ for even n and −xⁿ for odd n, which is why exactly the odd-degree terms flip. The x² term is missing here, so only two signs change.
common_mistakes: Changing the sign of the constant 3.
